_source: Star Citizen game files via StarBreaker
_assumptions: Signature index order: rules.signatureTypes names the eight entries of RadarSystemGlobalParams.signatureSystemParams.signatureTypeParams; that the same order applies to emissionsParams (missiles[].emission.signature) and to radarObjectParams signatures (countermeasureAmmo[].radarSignatures) is inference from the records (docs/datacore/ordnance-sensors.md, Signatures).
Signature keys: a displayName of the form @hud_scanning_info_<key>_signature gives <key> (ir, em, cs, db, rs, id); any other displayName (@LOC_EMPTY on indices 6 and 7) keeps the index as its key.
Templates are left out: a row whose name is a placeholder or whose record name contains _template (summary.skippedTemplates lists them).
